result.scope_note: The claim compares two distinct time intervals: (1) from 1787 Constitution signing to Bill of Rights ratification, and (2) from congressional proposal to ratification. Both intervals fall within United States constitutional history. The first interval spans the gap between the Philadelphia Convention and the ratification of the first ten amendments. The second interval refers to the standard proposal-to-ratification timeline for constitutional amendments. No additional factual data is required to interpret the claim's structure; the comparison operator is determined by the actual dates involved.
